data: NVIDIA's net income for fiscal 2025, which ended January 26, 2025, was about $72.9 billion. I can't confirm Tesla's fiscal 2025 figure (calendar 2025) with enough confidence to state it as fact, and my recollection of it is uncertain, so please check it against Tesla's 10-K for 2025. If it is near $3.8 billion, NVIDIA's net income would be roughly 19 times larger. For reference, Tesla's 2024 net income was about $7.1 billion, so the comparison depends heavily on which year and which filing you use.
